protocol.splits: First five outcome seasons train; evaluate each of the final five with expanding earlier-season training. No within-season train/test split.
protocol.primaryMetric: Equal-season mean Brier; also report game-weighted Brier, log loss, each year, calibration, playoffs and record/playoff subgroups.
protocol.promotionRule: For the same feature timing and available inputs: improvement >=0.001 equal-season Brier, lower log loss, wins in >=4/5 seasons, and paired season-bootstrap upper bound below zero. This is a conservative engineering rule, not statistical proof. Subgroup and COVID sensitivity can veto promotion.
protocol.rateGap: 4 * (home record percentage - away record percentage), fitted coefficient and home term
limitations: Previously examined historical periods; no untouched confirmation.
Only five evaluation seasons; season-bootstrap intervals are descriptive.
Rarity reference is current selected cohort restricted by cutoff, not a reconstructable contemporaneous rolling 20-season archive.
Pregame MLB and lookback models answer different questions; do not rank their losses together.
MLB retains the source pipeline assumption that designated home is home except documented neutral games; missing neutral flags are not independently resolved here.
Cross-sport translation, counterfactual scoring and series independence are not validated by these tests.
